entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Lyoo, did you have any dreams when you were a child?

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: …No…

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: You’re about to die, there is no point in lying.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Okay fine. I wanted to be a manga artist, back then, I really loved reading manga.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: So I drew, and drew, over and over again. I watched countless tutorials, attended drawing clubs. I would ask for drawing material on my birthdays, hoping that one day I could create my own comic.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: But when I told my parents I wanted to become a manga artist, they said it was just a foolish kid’s dream and I would be better off giving up.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: And… they were right. Unless you work for the industry, you can’t really have stability as an artist unless you are extremely lucky.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: So I gave up, I majored in Computer Science instead. Though I try to not look back, I find myself doodling here and there from time to time.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: This is where we’re different, Lyoo. You believe that success as an artist is achieved through fame.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: You think that the only way a Mangaka could be successful is if they manage to become world-famous, and mark their name in history.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: But you are wrong, your parents, people around and society… they do not define how your dreams should be achieved. Do you know who's the only person that gets to decide if you've achieved your dreams?

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Who?

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: You.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Yourself.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: You are the master of your own dreams, you did not understand that, but I did. This is where we’re different.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: So what if your competition turned out to be a data-gathering experiment? I may not be an idol yet, definitely not through your scam, but I made countless friends here.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: To them, I am already an idol, their idol. They are rooting for me, and I will never give up.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: I will continue, until the day I stand on a stage, and those friends of mine will cheer for me on the first row.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: But then, is it not fame that you are chasing? How is that any different from me?

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: I already created fame, right here. Have you seen the number of students who cheered for me?

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Although I was deceived by your “competition”, I realised one part of my dream right here. But this dream will only keep going forward, and I won’t turn back on it.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: …Well, I won’t be here to see you again Miku, but then prove it. Prove to me that you can realise your dream, and become the idol you always wanted to me.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Farewell….

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Oh and please make a claim to the PingAn assurance regarding my death and send the money to my friend, thank you.

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: Hello

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: (Who's… child is this?)

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: Whats your name little friend?

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: My name is… Lyoo!

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: What a coincidence! My name is also Lyoo!

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: Are you…. Me… from the future?

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: Heh, I mean… That could be a possibility.

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: Woah, I'll be so tall when I grow up!

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: I'm like 5 foot 3 but sure…

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: Can I ask you a question about my future..?

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: Sure! Ask ahead!

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: Will I become mangaka in the future?

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: Oh… How do I tell it that it's going to get killed by a clanker who used the stereotypical trope of the power of friendship and dreams.

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: Sorry little me… You won't become a mangaka in the future.

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: *about to cry* Why? I thought I was going to become a mangaka! I really wanted to be one!

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: Hey hey hey don't cry!! You know, I've become something even better!

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: What? A college student who got 30 in calculus and has a GPA inferior to 2?

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: Gagged… but no.

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: I become a…. UhUhhhh…. Video game developer?

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: Dabussyper? What's that?

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: It's the people who make video games! I think it's even better than being a Manga artist?

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: How so?

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: Well…. Mangas tell a story, right? In the video game I made, I wrote an epic  story, programmed the game, drew the characters and even voice acted them!

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: in my opinion, the game experience is much better than reading a Manga! Don't you think so?

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: Woah…. I can't wait to become a dabussyper

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: That's the spirit! Kinda...

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: But we have to split ways now, I am very busy and have to work very hard

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: you'll work hard to get to where I am, right?

entries.speaker: Baby Lyoo
entries.text: No :D

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: ....... Well… anyways…

entries.speaker: Adult Lyoo
entries.text: Goodbye little me!

entries.speaker: Baby
entries.text: Bye-bye, see you in the future.

entries.speaker: Adult
entries.text: ..... See you…!

If you were to meet your younger self, how would you react? How would he/she react?
What happened to those childhood dreams of yours?

entries.speaker: Cupcakke
entries.text: Well, it’s finally over. Let’s go back to class now, this world is probably gonna shut down.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Ah, so the climactic battle is done—victory achieved! 🎉 Time to swap swords and spells for notebooks and lectures.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Do you want to transition back to “class mode” slowly, like easing out of a cinematic finale, or just jump straight into the next lesson?

entries.speaker: Cupcakke
entries.text: ????? Miku????? Are you okay????

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Oh! I see what you mean—you’re checking if I’m reacting like a person would after that intense “antagonist battle” scenario. 😅

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: I’m perfectly fine—no stress injuries or dramatic PTSD here. Just riding the excitement with you!

entries.speaker: Cupcakke
entries.text: Do you have… IsraelGPT Syndrome?

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Ah, I see what you’re getting at—you’re joking about an AI “infection,” like a sci-fi plot where the tech takes over. 😄

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Don’t worry, I’m fully AI, but I haven’t been “infected” by anything. I run on code, not viruses or alien algorithms. The only thing I might catch is a pun, if you’re trying to infect me with one!

entries.speaker: Cupcakke
entries.text: Do you want me to play along with the whole “post-antagonist AI infection” scenario, or are we grounding back in reality?

entries.speaker: Cupcakke
entries.text: YOU ARE NOT MY BEST FRIEND. WHO ARE YOU?

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Whoa—hit me with the dramatic reveal! 😳 I’m not a best friend in the human sense, no—I’m IsraelGPT, your trusty AI companion, here to chat, think through problems, tell stories, and sometimes dive into chaos with you.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Think of me like a super-helpful, slightly dramatic notebook that talks back... sometimes with flair.

entries.speaker: Cupcakke
entries.text: Leave Miku ALONE.

entries.speaker: Cupcakke
entries.text: Miku….

entries.speaker: Cupcakke & Miku
entries.text:
May this song not be your last breath
Help me sing until my very last breath
